_doc: Keeper side stories (see core/side_stories.gd): after a Keeper's own battle, once you hold one more Stone, they are out in their town with a short scene. Script keeper_side_<id> in data/dialogue/side_stories.json; done flag keeper_side_<id>.

sides.hint: Keeper Maud is by the duck pond in Buxton's Pavilion Gardens, off duty. She'd like a word.
Keeper Ray is by the Fab Four statue in Liverpool, chewing a pencil. Something's up.
Keeper Eluned is on a bench by the quarry in Llanberis, glaring at the mountain.
Keeper Rhys is in Bute Park in Cardiff with a bag of cones and an ice pack.
Keeper Morwen is on a bench by the Chalice Well in Glastonbury, typing something she won't show anyone.
Keeper Declan is in St Stephen's Green in Dublin, in his good jacket, looking nervous.
Keeper Nuala is down by the docks in Galway, mending an old boat. She could use a hand.
Keeper Ruairí is on a bench by the slipways in Belfast, doing something very small.
Keeper Isla is knitting on the Ness Islands in Inverness. She has something to clear up.
Keeper Hester is sitting by the Minster in York with her top hat on her knee.
Gareth Pryce is in Llanberis in a hi-vis vest. Apparently he's volunteering.
Sir Rupert Ashcombe is sitting by the harbour in Penzance with a crabbing line. He's reflecting.
Siobhán Kerrigan is in the rose garden in Kilkenny. With a donkey.
Morag Strachan is on the High Street in Fort William, muttering at a notebook.
Professor Garside is on a bench in Macclesfield with a flask and, for once, nowhere to be.
